name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: legal deadlines first, then certificates, plans, money and quiet claims

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: The legal deadlines from /attention. Every line names the rule that set it.
sections.sql: select case when standing = 'deemed' then 'cover deemed' else item end as item, ref, worker, site, to_char(due_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as due, standing from v_deadlines where basis = 'law' and standing in ('overdue', 'deemed', 'due soon') order by due_at

sections.title: Certificates and plans
sections.sql: select ref, worker, site, coalesce(capacity, '') as capacity, cert_to, cert_standing, coalesce(plan_ref, '') as plan, coalesce(plan_status, '') as plan_status, plan_review_on from v_claims where status = 'open' and (cert_standing in ('expired', 'expiring', 'no certificate') or (plan_status = 'agreed' and plan_review_on < current_date + 7)) order by cert_to nulls first

sections.title: Open claims
sections.sql: select ref, worker, site, nature, liability, capacity, cert_to, week_no as week from v_claims where status = 'open' order by site, ref

name: deadlines
title: Statutory deadlines
subtitle: Every clock the law starts on an injury or a claim, and how each was met

sections.title: Open
sections.sql: select item, ref, worker, site, to_char(due_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as due, standing, rule from v_deadlines where standing not in ('done', 'done late') order by due_at

sections.title: Met late in the last 12 months
sections.sql: select item, ref, worker, site, due_on, to_char(done_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as done from v_deadlines where standing = 'done late' and due_at >= now() - interval '12 months' order by due_at desc

name: money
title: Money
subtitle: Paid on claims, waiting to come back from the insurer, and estimated

sections.title: By site, this year
sections.sql: select site, currency, count(*)::int as claims, sum(paid_cents)::int as paid_cents, sum(awaiting_reimbursement_cents)::int as waiting_cents, sum(coalesce(estimate_cents, 0))::int as estimate_cents from v_claims where received_on >= date_trunc('year', current_date) group by site, currency order by site

sections.title: Waiting on reimbursement
sections.sql: select ref, claim_ref, worker, insurer, paid_on, amount_cents, currency, days, standing from v_reimbursements where reimbursed_on is null order by paid_on
